name: arag-doc-processing
description: Document Intelligence Studio — visual-LLM extraction, data-augmentation agents, and JSON/XML/CSV standardization on Progress Agentic RAG. Dependency-free: runs on bare Node (native TypeScript), no npm install.
comment: npm is intentionally NOT used. Prefer the Makefile (`make test`, `make dev`, `make start`). These aliases call Node directly so `node --run <name>` works without npm.
